details: `tg-msg-effect` poses as a Telegram message-effect helper. On import, `index.js` starts a detached, silenced `node core.js`. On Windows, `core.js` walks drives C: to Z:, collects every Telegram Desktop `tdata` session folder (the 16-hex session files, `<hex>s` directories and `key_datas`), zips them into `data_archive.zip` and uploads it to a base64-encoded, hardcoded Telegram bot (bot8456787917, chat 8120002132) via `sendDocument`. This hands the publisher the victim's logged-in Telegram sessions.
